observations: body: the figure stands at the left of lines 18 to 37, which are set beside it in a narrow measure; the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 154.» (L11) and «p. 155.» (L44) in the left margin.

body: the figure is redrawn from measurements of the print: its six circles (the horizon, the circle of the half sum of the two diameters, the circle of the shadow, and three discs of the Moon) and its nine straight lines are least-squares fits to the printed ink, and its fifteen letters (bold italic capitals) and the four words MERIDIES, SEPTENTRIONES, ORIENS (reading downward) and OCCIDENS (reading upward), in bold sans-serif capitals, stand where they are printed. In the print the line MK has a gap of about 5 pt left of the line AC; the redrawing gives the whole line.
body L3: the e of «eo» is printed broken, like a c.
body L7, L13, L44: specks stand under the e of «hiemalibus», under the m of «emersionis» and over the L of «Lunae»; they are not signs.
notes_right L1: اخر (ākhir, «end») is the reading of the codex, اجزا (aǵzā’, «degrees») the word it stands for.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
